_comment: Loadout pictures (runbooth.py --phase 3). start: the fight frame the battle is held at before the first press; press: frames the button is held; gap: frames between the V-Skill and V-Trigger of one side; default: fight frames to run after the press before the grab; fighters: per-fighter overrides, a number for both choices or {"1": n, "2": n} per choice, e.g. {"RYU": {"vskill": {"2": 30}, "vtrigger": 52}}; crop: the 16:9 window around the fighter and its effects, at least height_fraction of the frame high, with margin on each side of what the grab shows; burst: frames either side of the chosen one that --burst also grabs for review.
